message: The other day, I was chatting with a neighbor about smoke alarms and how I always double-check mine every six months. She rolled her eyes, saying she never bothers because she’s never had a fire. Fast forward to last night—her alarm went off because she accidentally burned dinner. I couldn’t help but give a friendly ‘I told you so’ nudge. We laughed it off, but it reminded me that even small things like checking smoke alarms can make a difference. Have you had a moment like that where being prepared paid off?
